sentence: Adoption lifts organisational performance by way of the quality of decisions and the performance of business processes, with process innovation, automation and organisational learning as partial, complementary mediators
passage: [Zebec & Indihar Stemberger (2024), p. 1] "AI adoption increases organisational performance through decision-making and business process performance. Process automation, organisational learning and process innovation are significant complementary partial mediators"

gemini.note: The sentence accurately paraphrases the causal relationships and the specific complementary partial mediators exactly as described in the passage.
